en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing stone ruins on a hill surrounded by vegetation, with two small human figures near an arched opening. The front caption at the bottom reads "Pécs" on the left and "Tettyei romok" on the right. The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, an address, and a magenta Hungarian postage stamp marked "MAGYARORSZÁG 8 FILLÉR", with a circular postmark from Pécs dated November 24, 1928. Printer information "Barasits Budapest" and a copyright line with the year 1927 appear at the bottom.
